souls.name: Next to Enigma
souls.instruction: In the pool of water beside Enigma. Right-click it.

souls.name: Two Plates
souls.instruction: Two players have to stand on the nearby pressure plates at the same time.

souls.name: Between Branches
souls.instruction: Break the glass block wedged between the branches. Larva Silk is what cuts it.

souls.name: Roy
souls.instruction: Bought from Roy, for Deadgehog Spine and motes.

souls.name: Lonely Avaeikx
souls.instruction: Sit with the NPC and stay there. It takes about three minutes.

souls.name: Spinning Runes
souls.instruction: Click the runes until every one of them faces the Runic Tree.

souls.name: Castle Fleespook
souls.instruction: Follow the Fleespook and keep up with it until it stops.

souls.name: Lagoon Cave
souls.instruction: At the end of the parkour course. Getting there is the whole puzzle.

souls.name: Leap of Faith
souls.instruction: On a floating platform reached across invisible barriers.

souls.name: Ikrus
souls.instruction: Given by Ikrus once his quest is finished.
